statements.text: Adriatic Logistics Partners operates six distribution centres across the Adriatic region.

expectedSupport.passage: The Company operates six distribution centres located in Croatia, Slovenia, and northern Italy.

statements.text: The business has combined strong revenue growth with meaningful margin expansion over the past two years.

expectedSupport.passage: The Company generated revenue of EUR 92 million in FY2024, up from EUR 71 million in FY2023, representing sustained double-digit growth over the period.
Reported EBITDA margin expanded to 24% in FY2024, from 19% two years prior, driven by network densification and improved asset utilisation.

statements.text: The Company employs 210 staff across its network.

expectedSupport.passage: The Company employs 210 staff across its six distribution centres, with the majority based at the Zagreb headquarters.
The Company employs 240 staff as of March 2025, not 210 as stated in our initial memo, reflecting two distribution-centre openings completed during the diligence period.
